// Add the matching entries to internal/diag/diag.go.
//
//   JSC_INVALID_CAST (warning)
//   JSC_TYPE_MISMATCH (warning)

//   JSC_DUP_VAR_DECLARATION (warning)

//   JSC_INTERFACE_METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (warning)
//   JSC_HIDDEN_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_MISMATCH (warning)
//   JSC_HIDDEN_SUPERCLASS_PROPERTY_MISMATCH (warning)

// A central reporter for all type violations: places where the programmer has annotated a variable
// (or property) with one type, but has assigned another type to it.
// 
// <p>Also doubles as a central repository for all type violations, so that type-based optimizations
// (like AmbiguateProperties) can be fault-tolerant.
type TypeValidator struct {
	Compiler *Compiler
	// TODO: Java type JSTypeRegistry not mapped
	TypeRegistry JSTypeRegistry
	AllBitwisableValueTypes jstype.JSType
	NullOrUndefined jstype.JSType
	PromiseOfUnknownType jstype.JSType
	IterableOrAsyncIterable jstype.JSType
	// TODO: Java type SubtypingMode not mapped
	SubtypingMode SubtypingMode
	// TODO: Java type TypeMismatch.Accumulator not mapped
	Mismatches TypeMismatch.Accumulator
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:112
func NewTypeValidator(compiler *Compiler) *TypeValidator {
	t := &TypeValidator{}
	t.compiler = compiler
	t.typeRegistry = compiler.getTypeRegistry()
	t.allBitwisableValueTypes = typeRegistry.createUnionType(STRING_TYPE, NUMBER_TYPE, BOOLEAN_TYPE, NULL_TYPE, VOID_TYPE)
	t.nullOrUndefined = typeRegistry.getNativeType(JSTypeNative.NULL_VOID)
	t.promiseOfUnknownType = typeRegistry.createTemplatizedType(
            typeRegistry.getNativeObjectType(JSTypeNative.PROMISE_TYPE),
            typeRegistry.getNativeType(JSTypeNative.UNKNOWN_TYPE))
	t.iterableOrAsyncIterable = typeRegistry.createUnionType(
            typeRegistry.getNativeObjectType(JSTypeNative.ITERATOR_TYPE),
            typeRegistry.getNativeObjectType(JSTypeNative.ASYNC_ITERATOR_TYPE))
	return t
}

// Utility function that attempts to get an instance type from a potential constructor type
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:129
func GetInstanceOfCtor(t jstype.JSType) *jstype.ObjectType {
	if t == nil {
		return nil
	}
	ctor := JSType.ToMaybeFunctionType(t.Dereference())
	if ctor != nil && ctor.IsConstructor() {
		return ctor.GetInstanceType()
	}
	return nil
}

// Gets a list of type violations.
// 
// <p>For each violation, one element is the expected type and the other is the type that is
// actually found. Order is not significant.
// 
// <p>NOTE(dimvar): Even though TypeMismatch is a pair, the passes that call this method never use
// it as a pair; they just add both its elements to a set of invalidating types. Consider just
// maintaining a set of types here instead of a set of type pairs.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:150
func (c *TypeValidator) GetMismatches() []TypeMismatch {
	return c.mismatches.GetMismatches()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:154
func (c *TypeValidator) SetSubtypingMode(mode SubtypingMode) {
	c.subtypingMode = mode
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:163
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectValidTypeofName(n *rhino.Node, found string) {
	c.compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, UNKNOWN_TYPEOF_VALUE, found))
}

// Expect the type to be an object, or a type convertible to object. If the expectation is not
// met, issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// 
// Returns: True if there was no warning, false if there was a mismatch.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:173
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectObject(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) bool {
	if !typ.MatchesObjectContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, OBJECT_TYPE)
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// Expect the type to be an object. Unlike expectObject, a type convertible to object is not
// acceptable.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:185
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectActualObject(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.IsObject() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, OBJECT_TYPE)
	}
}

// Expect the type to contain an object sometimes. If the expectation is not met, issue a warning
// at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:195
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectAnyObject(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	anyObjectType := GetNativeType(NO_OBJECT_TYPE)
	if !anyObjectType.IsSubtypeOf(typ) && !typ.IsEmptyType() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, anyObjectType)
	}
}

// Expect the type to autobox to be an Iterable.
// 
// Returns: True if there was no warning, false if there was a mismatch.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:206
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectAutoboxesToIterable(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) bool {
	if typ.IsUnionType() {
		for _, alt := range typ.ToMaybeUnionType().GetAlternates() {
			alt = func() any { if alt.IsBoxableScalar() { return alt.AutoboxesTo() }; return alt }()
			if !alt.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(ITERABLE_TYPE)) {
				Mismatch(n, msg, typ, ITERABLE_TYPE)
				return false
			}
		}
	} else {
		autoboxedType := func() any { if typ.IsBoxableScalar() { return typ.AutoboxesTo() }; return typ }()
		if !autoboxedType.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(ITERABLE_TYPE)) {
			Mismatch(n, msg, typ, ITERABLE_TYPE)
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Expect the type to autobox to be an Iterable or AsyncIterable.
// 
// Returns: The unwrapped variants of the iterable(s), or empty if not iterable.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:233
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectAutoboxesToIterableOrAsyncIterable(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) *jstype.JSType {
	maybeBoxed := JsIterables.MaybeBoxIterableOrAsyncIterable(typ, typeRegistry)
	if maybeBoxed.IsMatch() {
		return Optional.Of(maybeBoxed.GetTemplatedType())
	}
	Mismatch(n, msg, typ, iterableOrAsyncIterable)
	return Optional.Empty()
}

	if !GetNativeType(GENERATOR_TYPE).IsSubtypeOf(typ) {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, GENERATOR_TYPE)
	}
}

	if !GetNativeType(ASYNC_GENERATOR_TYPE).IsSubtypeOf(typ) {

	}
}

// Expect the type to be a supertype of `Promise`.
// 
// <p>`Promise` is the <em>lower</em> bound of the declared return type, since that's what async
// functions always return; the user can't return an instance of a more specific type.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:265
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectValidAsyncReturnType(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType) {
	if promiseOfUnknownType.IsSubtypeOf(typ) {
		return
	}
	err := JSError.Make(n, INVALID_ASYNC_RETURN_TYPE, typ.ToString())
	RegisterMismatchAndReport(typ, promiseOfUnknownType, err)
}

// Expect the type to be an ITemplateArray or supertype of ITemplateArray.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:275
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectITemplateArraySupertype(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !GetNativeType(I_TEMPLATE_ARRAY_TYPE).IsSubtypeOf(typ) {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, I_TEMPLATE_ARRAY_TYPE)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a string, or a type convertible to string. If the expectation is not met,
// issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:285
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectString(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesStringContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, STRING_TYPE)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a number, or a type convertible to number. If the expectation is not met,
// issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:295
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectNumber(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesNumberContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, NUMBER_TYPE)
	} else {
		ExpectNumberStrict(n, typ, msg)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a number or a subtype.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:304
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectNumberStrict(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(NUMBER_TYPE)) {
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE, msg, typ, GetNativeType(NUMBER_TYPE), nil, nil)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:311
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectMatchingTypesStrict(n *rhino.Node, left jstype.JSType, right jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !left.IsSubtypeOf(right) && !right.IsSubtypeOf(left) {
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE, msg, right, left, nil, nil)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a valid operand to a bitwise operator. This includes numbers, any type
// convertible to a number, or any other primitive type (undefined|null|boolean|string).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:321
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectBitwiseable(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesNumberContext() && !typ.IsSubtypeOf(allBitwisableValueTypes) {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, allBitwisableValueTypes)
	} else {
		ExpectNumberStrict(n, typ, msg)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a number or string, or a type convertible to a number or symbol. If the
// expectation is not met, issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:333
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectNumberOrSymbol(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesNumberContext() && !typ.MatchesSymbolContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, NUMBER_SYMBOL)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a string or symbol, or a type convertible to a string. If the expectation
// is not met, issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:343
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectStringOrSymbol(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesStringContext() && !typ.MatchesSymbolContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, STRING_SYMBOL)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be unknown or a comparable type (bigint, number, or string)
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:350
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectUnknownOrComparable(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER_STRING)) && !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER_STRING_OBJECT)) {
		if typ.MatchesNumberContext() || typ.MatchesStringContext() {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE, msg, typ, GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER_STRING), nil, nil)
		} else {
			Mismatch(n, msg, typ, BIGINT_NUMBER_STRING)
		}
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a number or string or symbol, or a type convertible to a number or
// string. If the expectation is not met, issue a warning at the provided node's source code
// position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:368
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectStringOrNumberOrSymbol(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.MatchesNumberContext() && !typ.MatchesStringContext() && !typ.MatchesSymbolContext() {
		Mismatch(n, msg, typ, NUMBER_STRING_SYMBOL)
	} else {
		ExpectStringOrNumberOrSymbolStrict(n, typ, msg)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:378
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectStringOrNumberOrSymbolStrict(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(NUMBER_STRING_SYMBOL)) {
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE, msg, typ, GetNativeType(NUMBER_STRING_SYMBOL), nil, nil)
	}
}

// Expect the type to be a bigint or number, or a type convertible to number. If the expectation
// is not met, issue a warning at the provided node's source code position.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:389
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectBigIntOrNumber(n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string) {
	if !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER)) && !typ.IsSubtypeOf(GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER_OBJECT)) {
		if typ.MatchesNumberContext() {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE, msg, typ, GetNativeType(BIGINT_NUMBER), nil, nil)
		} else {
			Mismatch(n, msg, typ, BIGINT_NUMBER)
		}
	}
}

// Expect the type to be anything but the null or void type. If the expectation is not met, issue
// a warning at the provided node's source code position. Note that a union type that includes the
// void type and at least one other type meets the expectation.
// 
// Returns: Whether the expectation was met.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:409
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectNotNullOrUndefined(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, typ jstype.JSType, msg string, expectedType jstype.JSType) bool {
	c.x = = null) {
      //   this.initializeX()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:437
func containsForwardDeclaredUnresolvedName(typ jstype.JSType) bool {
	if typ.IsUnionType() {
		for _, alt := range typ.ToMaybeUnionType().GetAlternates() {
			if ContainsForwardDeclaredUnresolvedName(alt) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return typ.IsNoResolvedType()
}

// Expect that the type of a switch condition matches the type of its case condition.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:449
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectSwitchMatchesCase(n *rhino.Node, switchType jstype.JSType, caseType jstype.JSType) {
	if !switchType.CanTestForShallowEqualityWith(caseType) {
		Mismatch(n.GetFirstChild(), "case expression doesn't match switch", caseType, switchType)
	}
}

// Expect that the first type can be addressed with GETELEM syntax and that the second type is the
// right type for an index into the first type.
// 
// Param: n The GETELEM or COMPUTED_PROP node to issue warnings on.
// Param: objType The type we're indexing into (the left side of the GETELEM).
// Param: indexType The type inside the brackets of the GETELEM/COMPUTED_PROP.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:464
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectIndexMatch(n *rhino.Node, objType jstype.JSType, indexType jstype.JSType) {
	CheckState(n.IsGetElem() || n.IsOptChainGetElem() || n.IsComputedProp() || n.IsComputedFieldDef(), n)
	indexNode := func() any { if n.IsGetElem() { return n.GetLastChild() }; return n.GetFirstChild() }()
	if indexType.IsSymbolValueType() {
		return
	}
	if objType.IsUnknownType() {
		ExpectStringOrNumberOrSymbol(indexNode, indexType, "property access")
		return
	}
	dereferenced := objType.Dereference()
	if dereferenced != nil && dereferenced.GetTemplateTypeMap().HasTemplateKey(typeRegistry.GetObjectIndexKey()) {
		templateType := dereferenced.GetTemplateTypeMap().GetResolvedTemplateType(typeRegistry.GetObjectIndexKey())
		ExpectCanAssignTo(indexNode, indexType, templateType, "restricted index type")
	} else if dereferenced != nil && dereferenced.IsArrayType() {
		ExpectNumberOrSymbol(indexNode, indexType, "array access")
	} else if objType.IsStruct() {
		c.compiler.Report(JSError.Make(indexNode, ILLEGAL_PROPERTY_ACCESS, "'[]'", "struct"))
	} else if objType.MatchesObjectContext() {
		ExpectStringOrSymbol(indexNode, indexType, "property access")
	} else {
		Mismatch(n, "only arrays or objects can be accessed", objType, typeRegistry.CreateUnionType(ARRAY_TYPE, OBJECT_TYPE))
	}
}

// Expect that the first type can be assigned to a symbol of the second type.
// 
// Param: n The node to issue warnings on.
// Param: rightType The type on the RHS of the assign.
// Param: leftType The type of the symbol on the LHS of the assign.
// Param: owner The owner of the property being assigned to.
// Param: propName The name of the property being assigned to.
// Returns: True if the types matched, false otherwise.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:510
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectCanAssignToPropertyOf(n *rhino.Node, rightType jstype.JSType, leftType jstype.JSType, owner *rhino.Node, propName string) bool {
	var typeNameSupplier Supplier<String>
	if n.IsMemberFieldDef() {
		classType := n.GetGrandparent().GetJSType().AssertFunctionType()
		typeNameSupplier =  - > classType.getInstanceType().toString()
	} else {
		typeNameSupplier =  - > typeRegistry.getReadableTypeName(owner)
	}
	return ExpectCanAssignToPropertyOf(n, rightType, leftType, GetJSType(owner), typeNameSupplier, propName)
}

// Expect that the first type can be assigned to a symbol of the second type.
// 
// Param: n The node to issue warnings on.
// Param: rightType The type on the RHS of the assign.
// Param: leftType The type of the symbol on the LHS of the assign.
// Param: ownerType The owner of the property being assigned to.
// Param: propName The name of the property being assigned to.
// Returns: True if the types matched, false otherwise.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:533
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectCanAssignToPropertyOf(n *rhino.Node, rightType jstype.JSType, leftType jstype.JSType, ownerType jstype.JSType, typeNameSupplier Supplier<String>, propName string) bool {
	if leftType.IsTemplateType() {
		left := leftType.ToMaybeTemplateType()
		if rightType.ContainsReferenceAncestor(left) || rightType.IsUnknownType() || left.IsUnknownType() {
			return true
		} else {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNING, "assignment to property " + propName + " of " + typeNameSupplier.Get(), rightType, leftType, Newmap[]struct{}(), Newmap[]struct{}())
			return false
		}
	}
	if !leftType.IsNoType() && !rightType.IsSubtypeOf(leftType) {
		if ownerType.IsFunctionPrototypeType() {
			ownerFn := ownerType.ToObjectType().GetOwnerFunction()
			if ownerFn.IsInterface() && rightType.IsFunctionType() && leftType.IsFunctionType() {
				return true
			}
		}
		Mismatch(n, "assignment to property " + propName + " of " + typeNameSupplier.Get(), rightType, leftType)
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// Expect that the first type can be assigned to a symbol of the second type.
// 
// Param: n The node to issue warnings on.
// Param: rightType The type on the RHS of the assign.
// Param: leftType The type of the symbol on the LHS of the assign.
// Param: msg An extra message for the mismatch warning, if necessary.
// Returns: True if the types matched, false otherwise.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:592
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectCanAssignTo(n *rhino.Node, rightType jstype.JSType, leftType jstype.JSType, msg string) bool {
	if leftType.IsTemplateType() {
		left := leftType.ToMaybeTemplateType()
		if rightType.ContainsReferenceAncestor(left) || rightType.IsUnknownType() || left.IsUnknownType() {
			return true
		} else {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNING, msg, rightType, leftType, Newmap[]struct{}(), Newmap[]struct{}())
			return false
		}
	}
	if !rightType.IsSubtypeOf(leftType) {
		Mismatch(n, msg, rightType, leftType)
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// Expect that the type of an argument matches the type of the parameter that it's fulfilling.
// 
// Param: n The node to issue warnings on.
// Param: argType The type of the argument.
// Param: paramType The type of the parameter.
// Param: callNode The call node, to help with the warning message.
// Param: ordinal The argument ordinal, to help with the warning message.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:631
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectArgumentMatchesParameter(n *rhino.Node, argType jstype.JSType, paramType jstype.JSType, callNode *rhino.Node, ordinal int) {
	if !argType.IsSubtypeOf(paramType) {
		Mismatch(n, "actual parameter " + ordinal + " of " + typeRegistry.GetReadableTypeNameNoDeref(callNode.GetFirstChild()) + " does not match formal parameter", argType, paramType)
	}
}

// Expect that the first type is the direct superclass of the second type.
// 
// Param: n The node where warnings should point to.
// Param: superObject The expected super instance type.
// Param: subObject The sub instance type.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:653
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectSuperType(n *rhino.Node, superObject *jstype.ObjectType, subObject *jstype.ObjectType) {
	subCtor := subObject.GetConstructor()
	implicitProto := subObject.GetImplicitPrototype()
	declaredSuper := func() any { if implicitProto == nil { return nil }; return implicitProto.GetImplicitPrototype() }()
	if declaredSuper != nil && declaredSuper.IsTemplatizedType() {
		declaredSuper = declaredSuper.ToMaybeTemplatizedType().GetReferencedType()
	}
	if declaredSuper != nil && !func() bool { _, ok := superObject.(UnknownType); return ok }() && !declaredSuper.Equals(superObject) {
		if declaredSuper.Equals(GetNativeType(OBJECT_TYPE)) {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(superObject, declaredSuper, JSError.Make(n, MISSING_EXTENDS_TAG_WARNING, subObject.ToString()))
		} else {
			Mismatch(n, "mismatch in declaration of superclass type", superObject, declaredSuper)
		}
		if !subCtor.HasCachedValues() {
			subCtor.SetPrototypeBasedOn(superObject)
		}
	}
}

// Expect that an ES6 class's extends clause is actually a supertype of the given class. Compares
// the registered supertype, which is taken from the JSDoc if present, otherwise from the AST,
// with the type in the extends node of the AST.
// 
// Param: n The node where warnings should point to.
// Param: subCtor The sub constructor type.
// Param: astSuperCtor The expected super constructor from the extends node in the AST.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:688
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectExtends(n *rhino.Node, subCtor *jstype.FunctionType, astSuperCtor *jstype.FunctionType) {
	if astSuperCtor == nil || !astSuperCtor.IsConstructor() && !astSuperCtor.IsInterface() {
		return
	}
	if astSuperCtor.IsConstructor() != subCtor.IsConstructor() {
		return
	}
	astSuperInstance := astSuperCtor.GetInstanceType()
	if subCtor.IsConstructor() {
		registeredSuperCtor := subCtor.GetSuperClassConstructor()
		if registeredSuperCtor != nil {
			registeredSuperInstance := registeredSuperCtor.GetInstanceType()
			if !astSuperInstance.Equals(registeredSuperInstance) {
				Mismatch(n, "mismatch in declaration of superclass type", astSuperInstance, registeredSuperInstance)
			}
		}
	} else if subCtor.IsInterface() {
	}
}

// Expect that it's valid to assign something to a given type's prototype.
// 
// <p>Most of these checks occur during TypedScopeCreator, so we just handle very basic cases here
// 
// <p>For example, assuming `Foo` is a constructor, `Foo.prototype = 3;` will warn because `3` is
// not an object.
// 
// Param: ownerType The type of the object whose prototype is being changed. (e.g. `Foo` above)
// Param: node Node to issue warnings on (e.g. `3` above)
// Param: rightType the rvalue type being assigned to the prototype (e.g. `number` above)
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:732
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectCanAssignToPrototype(ownerType jstype.JSType, node *rhino.Node, rightType jstype.JSType) {
	if ownerType.IsFunctionType() {
		functionType := ownerType.ToMaybeFunctionType()
		if functionType.IsConstructor() {
			ExpectObject(node, rightType, "cannot override prototype with non-object")
		}
	}
}

// Expect that the first type can be cast to the second type. The first type must have some
// relationship with the second.
// 
// Param: n The node where warnings should point.
// Param: targetType The type being cast to.
// Param: sourceType The type being cast from.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:749
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectCanCast(n *rhino.Node, targetType jstype.JSType, sourceType jstype.JSType) {
	if !sourceType.CanCastTo(targetType) {
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(sourceType, targetType, JSError.Make(n, INVALID_CAST, sourceType.ToString(), targetType.ToString()))
	} else if !sourceType.IsSubtypeOf(targetType) {
		c.mismatches.RegisterMismatch(n, sourceType, targetType)
	}
}

// Expect that the given variable has not been declared with a type.
// 
// Param: sourceName The name of the source file we're in.
// Param: n The node where warnings should point to.
// Param: parent The parent of {@code n}.
// Param: var The variable that we're checking.
// Param: variableName The name of the variable.
// Param: newType The type being applied to the variable. Mostly just here for the benefit of the
//     warning.
// Returns: The variable we end up with. Most of the time, this will just be {@code var}, but in
//     some rare cases we will need to declare a new var with new source info.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:775
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectUndeclaredVariable(sourceName string, input CompilerInput, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node, v TypedVar, variableName string, newType jstype.JSType) TypedVar {
	newVar := v
	varType := v.GetType()
	if varType != nil && varType != typeRegistry.GetNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE) && newType != nil && newType != typeRegistry.GetNativeType(UNKNOWN_TYPE) {
		if v.GetInput() == nil {
			s := v.GetScope()
			s.Undeclare(v)
			newVar = s.Declare(variableName, n, varType, input, false)
			n.SetJSType(varType)
			if parent.IsVar() {
				if n.HasChildren() {
					n.GetFirstChild().SetJSType(varType)
				}
			} else if parent.IsExprResult() {
				n.SetJSType(varType)
			} else {
				CheckState(parent.IsFunction() || parent.IsClass())
				parent.SetJSType(varType)
			}
		} else {
			allowDupe := HasDuplicateDeclarationSuppression(compiler, v.GetNameNode())
			if !allowDupe {
				if !newType.Equals(varType) {
					c.compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, DUP_VAR_DECLARATION_TYPE_MISMATCH, variableName, newType.ToString(), v.GetInputName(), String.ValueOf(v.GetNameNode().GetLineno()), varType.ToString()))
				} else if !v.GetParentNode().IsExprResult() {
					c.compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, DUP_VAR_DECLARATION, variableName, v.GetInputName(), String.ValueOf(v.GetNameNode().GetLineno())))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return newVar
}

// Expect that all properties on interfaces that this type implements are implemented and
// correctly typed.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:855
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectAllInterfaceProperties(n *rhino.Node, typ *jstype.FunctionType) {
	instance := typ.GetInstanceType()
	for _, implemented := range typ.GetAllImplementedInterfaces() {
		ExpectInterfaceProperties(n, instance, implemented)
	}
	for _, extended := range typ.GetExtendedInterfaces() {
		ExpectInterfaceProperties(n, instance, extended)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:865
func (t *TypeValidator) expectInterfaceProperties(n *rhino.Node, instance *jstype.ObjectType, ancestorInterface *jstype.ObjectType) {
	for _, prop := range ancestorInterface.GetOwnPropertyKeys() {
		ExpectInterfaceProperty(n, instance, ancestorInterface, prop)
	}
	if ancestorInterface.GetImplicitPrototype() != nil {
		for _, prop := range ancestorInterface.GetImplicitPrototype().GetOwnPropertyKeys() {
			ExpectInterfaceProperty(n, instance, ancestorInterface, prop)
		}
	}
}

// Expect that the property in an interface that this type implements is implemented and correctly
// typed.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:883
func (t *TypeValidator) expectInterfaceProperty(n *rhino.Node, instance *jstype.ObjectType, implementedInterface *jstype.ObjectType, propName Property.Key) {
	propSlot := instance.FindClosestDefinition(propName)
	if propSlot == nil || !instance.GetConstructor().IsInterface() && propSlot.IsOwnedByInterface() {
		if instance.GetConstructor().IsAbstract() || instance.GetConstructor().IsInterface() {
			return
		}
		if implementedInterface.GetPropertyType(propName).IsVoidable() {
			return
		}
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(instance, implementedInterface, JSError.Make(n, INTERFACE_METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, propName.HumanReadableName(), implementedInterface.GetReferenceName(), instance.ToString()))
	} else {
		local := propSlot.GetOwnerInstanceType().Equals(instance)
		if !local && instance.GetConstructor().IsInterface() {
			return
		}
		prop := propSlot.GetValue()
		propNode := func() any { if prop.GetDeclaration() == nil { return nil }; return prop.GetDeclaration().GetNode() }()
		propNode = func() any { if propNode == nil { return n }; return propNode }()
		CheckPropertyType(propNode, instance, implementedInterface, propName, prop.GetType())
	}
}

// Check the property is correctly typed (i.e. subtype of the parent property's type declaration).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:926
func (c *TypeValidator) CheckPropertyType(n *rhino.Node, instance jstype.JSType, parent *jstype.ObjectType, propertyName Property.Key, found jstype.JSType) {
	required := parent.GetPropertyType(propertyName)
	typeMap := instance.GetTemplateTypeMap()
	if !typeMap.IsEmpty() && required.HasAnyTemplateTypes() {
		required = required.Visit(TemplateTypeReplacer.ForPartialReplacement(typeRegistry, typeMap))
	}
	if found.IsSubtypeOf(required, c.subtypingMode) {
		return
	}
	err := JSError.Make(n, func() any { if parent.GetConstructor().IsInterface() { return HIDDEN_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_MISMATCH }; return HIDDEN_SUPERCLASS_PROPERTY_MISMATCH }(), propertyName.HumanReadableName(), parent.GetReferenceName(), required.ToString(), found.ToString(), instance.ToString())
	RegisterMismatchAndReport(found, required, err)
}

// For a concrete class, expect that all abstract methods that haven't been implemented by any of
// the super classes on the inheritance chain are implemented.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:957
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectAbstractMethodsImplemented(n *rhino.Node, ctorType *jstype.FunctionType) {
	CheckArgument(ctorType.IsConstructor())
	abstractMethodSuperTypeMap := NewLinkedHashMap<>()
	currSuperCtor := ctorType.GetSuperClassConstructor()
	if currSuperCtor == nil || !currSuperCtor.IsAbstract() {
		return
	}
	for currSuperCtor != nil && currSuperCtor.IsAbstract() {
		superType := currSuperCtor.GetInstanceType()
		for _, prop := range currSuperCtor.GetPrototype().GetOwnPropertyKeys() {
			maybeAbstractMethod := superType.FindPropertyType(prop).ToMaybeFunctionType()
			if maybeAbstractMethod != nil && maybeAbstractMethod.IsAbstract() && !abstractMethodSuperTypeMap.ContainsKey(prop) {
				abstractMethodSuperTypeMap.Put(prop, superType)
			}
		}
		currSuperCtor = currSuperCtor.GetSuperClassConstructor()
	}
	instance := ctorType.GetInstanceType()
	for _, entry := range abstractMethodSuperTypeMap.EntrySet() {
		Property.Key = entry.GetKey()
		superType := entry.GetValue()
		abstractMethod := instance.FindPropertyType(method).ToMaybeFunctionType()
		if abstractMethod == nil || abstractMethod.IsAbstract() {
			RegisterMismatchAndReport(instance, superType, JSError.Make(n, ABSTRACT_METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, method.HumanReadableName(), superType.ToString(), instance.ToString()))
		}
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:998
func (t *TypeValidator) mismatch(n *rhino.Node, msg string, found jstype.JSType, required JSTypeNative) {
	Mismatch(n, msg, found, GetNativeType(required))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1002
func (t *TypeValidator) mismatch(n *rhino.Node, msg string, found jstype.JSType, required jstype.JSType) {
	if !found.IsSubtypeOf(required, t.subtypingMode) {
		missing := nil
		mismatch := nil
		structuralType := nil
		if required.IsStructuralType() {
			structuralType = required
		} else if required.IsUnionType() {
			restrictedType := required.RestrictByNotNullOrUndefined()
			if restrictedType.IsStructuralType() {
				structuralType = restrictedType
			}
		}
		if structuralType != nil {
			missing = NewTreeSet<>()
			mismatch = NewTreeSet<>()
			requiredObject := structuralType.ToMaybeObjectType()
			foundObject := found.ToMaybeObjectType()
			if requiredObject != nil && foundObject != nil {
				for _, property := range requiredObject.GetPropertyNames() {
					propRequired := requiredObject.GetPropertyType(property)
					hasProperty := foundObject.HasProperty(property)
					if !propRequired.IsExplicitlyVoidable() || hasProperty {
						if hasProperty {
							if !foundObject.GetPropertyType(property).IsSubtypeOf(propRequired, subtypingMode) {
								mismatch.Add(property)
							}
						} else {
							missing.Add(property)
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		RegisterMismatchAndReport(n, TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNING, msg, found, required, missing, mismatch)
	}
}

// Used both for TYPE_MISMATCH_WARNING and INVALID_OPERAND_TYPE.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1045
func (t *TypeValidator) registerMismatchAndReport(n *rhino.Node, diagnostic string, msg string, found jstype.JSType, required jstype.JSType, missing map[string]struct{}, mismatch map[string]struct{}) {
	foundRequiredFormatted := FormatFoundRequired(msg, found, required, missing, mismatch)
	err := JSError.Make(n, diagnostic, foundRequiredFormatted)
	RegisterMismatchAndReport(found, required, err)
}

// Registers a type mismatch into the universe of mismatches owned by this pass.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1059
func (t *TypeValidator) registerMismatchAndReport(found jstype.JSType, required jstype.JSType, error diag.Diagnostic) {
	t.compiler.Report(error)
	t.mismatches.RegisterMismatch(error.Node(), found, required)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1064
func formatNodeLocation(node *rhino.Node) string {
	return String.Format("%s:%s:%s", node.GetSourceFileName(), node.GetLineno(), node.GetCharno())
}

// Formats a found/required error message.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1069
func formatFoundRequired(description string, found jstype.JSType, required jstype.JSType, missing map[string]struct{}, mismatch map[string]struct{}) string {
	foundStr := found.ToString()
	requiredStr := required.ToString()
	if foundStr.Equals(requiredStr) {
		foundStr = found.ToAnnotationString(Nullability.IMPLICIT)
		requiredStr = required.ToAnnotationString(Nullability.IMPLICIT)
	}
	if foundStr.Equals(requiredStr) {
		if found.IsEnumElementType() {
			foundStr = foundStr + " (enum definition: " + FormatNodeLocation(found.ToMaybeEnumElementType().GetEnumType().GetSource()) + ")"
		}
		if required.IsEnumElementType() {
			requiredStr = requiredStr + " (enum definition: " + FormatNodeLocation(required.ToMaybeEnumElementType().GetEnumType().GetSource()) + ")"
		}
	}
	missingStr := ""
	mismatchStr := ""
	if missing != nil && !missing.IsEmpty() {
		missingStr = Joiner.On(",").Join(missing)
	}
	if mismatch != nil && !mismatch.IsEmpty() {
		mismatchStr = Joiner.On(",").Join(mismatch)
	}
	if missingStr.Length() > 0 || mismatchStr.Length() > 0 {
		return Platform.FormatMessage(FOUND_REQUIRED_MISSING, description, foundStr, requiredStr, missingStr, mismatchStr)
	} else {
		return Platform.FormatMessage(FOUND_REQUIRED, description, foundStr, requiredStr)
	}
}

// This method gets the JSType from the Node argument and verifies that it is present.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1119
func (t *TypeValidator) getJSType(n *rhino.Node) jstype.JSType {
	return CheckNotNull(n.GetJSType(), "%s has no JSType attached", n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1123
func (t *TypeValidator) getNativeType(typeId JSTypeNative) jstype.JSType {
	return t.typeRegistry.GetNativeType(typeId)
}

// Param: decl The declaration to check.
// Returns: Whether duplicated declarations warnings should be suppressed for the given node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1131
func HasDuplicateDeclarationSuppression(compiler *Compiler, decl *rhino.Node) bool {
	originalDeclLevel := compiler.GetErrorLevel(JSError.Make(decl, DUP_VAR_DECLARATION, "dummy", "dummy"))
	return originalDeclLevel == CheckLevel.OFF
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1139
func (c *TypeValidator) ExpectWellFormedTemplatizedType(n *rhino.Node) {
	verifier := NewWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier(n)
	if n.GetJSType() != nil {
		n.GetJSType().Visit(verifier)
	}
}

}

type TypeValidatorFoo struct {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:1
func (c *TypeValidatorFoo) Prop() {
}

// Inner class TypeValidator.WellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier — ported as TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier.
type TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier struct {
	Node *rhino.Node
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:4
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) WellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier(node *rhino.Node) {
	c.node = node
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:9
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseDefault(typ jstype.JSType) Boolean {
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:14
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseEnumElementType(typ EnumElementType) Boolean {
	return typ.GetPrimitiveType() == nil || typ.GetPrimitiveType().Visit(c)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:19
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseFunctionType(typ *jstype.FunctionType) Boolean {
	for _, param := range typ.GetParameters() {
		if !param.GetJSType().Visit(c) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return typ.GetReturnType().Visit(c)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:29
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseNamedType(typ NamedType) Boolean {
	return typ.GetReferencedType().Visit(c)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:34
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseUnionType(typ *jstype.UnionType) Boolean {
	alternates := typ.GetAlternates()
	alternateCount := alternates.Size()
	for i := 0; i < alternateCount; i++ {
		alternative := alternates.Get(i)
		if !alternative.Visit(c) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:48
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseTemplatizedType(typ *jstype.TemplatizedType) Boolean {
	referencedTemplates := typ.GetReferencedType().GetTemplateTypeMap().GetTemplateKeys()
	for i := 0; i < typ.GetTemplateTypes().Size(); i++ {
		assignedType := typ.GetTemplateTypes().Get(i)
		if i < referencedTemplates.Size() {
			templateType := referencedTemplates.Get(i)
			if !assignedType.IsSubtype(templateType.GetBound()) {
				RegisterMismatchAndReport(assignedType, templateType.GetBound(), JSError.Make(node, RhinoErrorReporter.BOUNDED_GENERIC_TYPE_ERROR, assignedType.ToString(), templateType.GetReferenceName(), templateType.GetBound().ToString()))
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeValidator.java:73
func (c *TypeValidatorWellFormedTemplatizedTypeVerifier) CaseTemplateType(templateType TemplateType) Boolean {
	return !templateType.ContainsCycle() && templateType.GetBound().Visit(c)
}
